title: Sum Without Copying
hints: Count the places where a `Tracked` gets constructed in the starter: once per element when the parameter vector `items` is copied, and once per element for the loop variable `t`. For three elements that is 3 + 3 = 6 copies.
Both places want `const ... &`: `const std::vector<Tracked>& items` for the parameter and `const Tracked& t` for the loop variable. Read, never copy.
